model: Static extensible elastic rods with free XYZ coordinates, gravity and paired tube contact
modulus_status: First approximation from published Koolance Shore 80A hardness using the Gent elastomer correlation, rounded; not a measured PVC modulus or temperature-dependent constitutive law
dry_mass_basis: Approximation from Koolance's published 0.27 kg per 3 m product weight
scope: Visual 3D equilibrium study with clamped fitting exits and frictionless regularised paired-tube contact. No prescribed lateral lanes. No measured constitutive law, coiling memory, pressure, thermal softening or contact dynamics. Infrastructure routes remain prior nominal geometry.
modulus_correlation: E[MPa] = 0.0981*(56+7.66*S)/(0.137505*(254-2.54*S)); extrapolated to flexible PVC as an estimate
host_radius_basis: Retained 40 mm visual check floor, above published approximate 37 mm for selected 10/13 tubing; not a prediction of the current minimum radius.
accepted_length_basis: Nominal lengths accepted at 08beda1; preserve these when moving GPU terminals to the dimensioned Alphacool 34 mm pitch.
